resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register lists the tower as privately owned with the Arkansas Forestry Commission as cooperator. The 1939 survey, reproduced on the Central Lookouts page, ties the site to the state forestry commission on state-leased land. The story reports both; the sources do not say when ownership changed.

notes_for_editor: Two WebSearch calls found no build date, builder, staffing or fire record for this tower. Access is not stated anywhere, so access is left unset (brief said unknown). Brief agency Privately Owned matches the Register; the Central Lookouts page lists the Arkansas Forestry Commission, so the story keeps both. Leads not yet checked: Arkansas State Archives 1955 operations map and Forestry Commission unit records for Unit 5.
